content:
The run failed because the generated summary lacked the required 'Decision:' keyword, causing a regression in the verifier reward from 1.00 to 0.00.
The test_summary_contains_key_outputs failed with an AssertionError because 'Decision:' was missing from the summary text. While the summary correctly calculated revenue and recommended 'keep_90_day', it used 'Recommendation:' instead of the expected 'Decision:' label. The subprocess running pytest on /tests/test_outputs.py returned a non-zero exit code, triggering a failure in the test_legacy_pytest_suite wrapper.
